# M6.2 recorded decisions (human-reviewed)

**Status:** Binding for M6.2. **ADR-017 Accepted.** **Implementation has NOT started.**

This file records human-reviewed answers after the M6.2 architecture readiness audit. It is not executable.

**ADR-017** is **Accepted** in [`docs/architecture-baseline.md`](architecture-baseline.md) §20 ([ADR-017](architecture-baseline.md#adr-017--tenant-safe-accepted-path-persistence-through-owned-goal)). Do not edit ADR-002, ADR-005, ADR-013, ADR-014, ADR-015, or ADR-016 Decision rows.

## Adopted answers

| # | Decision | Answer |
|---|----------|--------|
| 1 | Public confirm / generate | **Remain public.** `POST /api/v1/goals/confirm` and `POST /api/v1/paths/generate` stay unauthenticated. No LearnerContext. No GR login. Protecting them requires a later ADR. |
| 2 | Write surface | **Accepted Path + nested Steps only**, under an already-owned Goal. Evidence persist HTTP is **not** M6.2. |
| 3 | Learner creation | **In-process only.** `persistLearner` stays explicit. No Learner HTTP, no login/membership auto-provision, no first-membership inference. |
| 4 | Golden Reference | **No change.** No GR login, org/Learner selectors, localStorage migration, server persist in the GR journey, or dual-write. Playwright E2E is regression only. |

## Ownership model (unchanged from ADR-016)

- Goal remains the **ownership root**.
- Path and Step ownership is **derived** through Goal (`learning_paths.goal_id` → `learning_path_steps.path_id`).
- No `organization_id` / `learner_id` on Path or Step.
- Sessions remain **User-only**.
- OrganizationContext remains request-scoped and membership-authoritative.
- LearnerContext remains server-resolved. Client `learnerId` is never authority.
- Legacy NULL/NULL Goals **fail closed** on tenant APIs.
- Unknown vs inaccessible remains indistinguishable.

## Data / migration

- **No expected migration** (no 0008) for M6.2 Path persistence.
- Existing `learning_paths.goal_id` is sufficient.
- **No UNIQUE(`goal_id`)** unless a separate human cardinality decision is made. Current repository may allow multiple paths per Goal.

## HTTP direction

`POST /api/v1/organizations/:organizationId/goals/:goalId/path`

Existing C7 GET derived routes remain. No Path list/update/delete, no Evidence POST, no Goal list/update/delete in M6.2.

## Out of M6.2

Evidence persist HTTP; Path list/update/delete; Goal list/update/delete; protect confirm/generate; GR login; GR server persistence; frontend organization/Learner selection; localStorage migration; dual-write; Learner provisioning HTTP; login auto-provision; Program; Cohort; Mastery; invitations; RBAC; SSO; `sessions.organization_id`; `sessions.learner_id`; Path/Step tenant FKs; fake legacy backfill; automatic UNIQUE(`goal_id`).
